headings: Development of the Company; Expansion of Business
Marine Engines, Related Marine Equipment, and Boating Parts and Accessories
paragraphs: We believe we are the world's largest recreational boat and yacht retailer, marina operator and superyacht services company. As of September 30, 2025, we have over 120 locations worldwide, including over 70 retail dealership locations, some of which include marinas. Collectively, with the IGY acquisition, as of September 30, 2025, we own or operate over 65 marina and storage locations worldwide. Through Fraser Yachts and Northrop & Johnson, we believe we are the largest superyacht services provider, operating locations across the globe. Cruisers Yachts, Aviara luxury dayboats, and Intrepid Powerboats all manufacture boats and yachts and recognize sales through our select retail dealership locations and through independent dealers. MarineMax provides finance and insurance services through wholly owned subsidiaries and operates MarineMax Vacations in Tortola, British Virgin Islands. The Company, through a wholly owned subsidiary, New Wave Innovations, also owns Boatyard, an industry-leading customer experience digital product company, and Boatzon, a boat and marine digital retail platform. Through Newcoast Financial Services, we provide third-party financing and insurance products for boats and yachts primarily for transactions not associated with our dealership locations.

As of September 30, 2025, the Retail Operations segment included the activity of over 70 retail locations in Alabama, California, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Washington and Wisconsin, where we sell new and used recreational boats, including pleasure and fishing boats, with a focus on premium brands in each segment. We also sell related marine products, including engines, trailers, parts, and accessories. In addition, we provide repair, maintenance, and slip and storage rentals; we arrange related boat financing, insurance, and extended service contracts; we offer boat and yacht brokerage sales and yacht charter services. In the British Virgin Islands, we offer the charter of power catamarans, through MarineMax Vacations. Fraser Yachts Group and Northrop & Johnson, leading superyacht brokerage and luxury yacht services companies with operations in multiple countries, are also included in this segment. IGY Marinas is also included in this segment. IGY Marinas maintains a network of strategically positioned luxury marinas situated in yachting and sport fishing destinations around the world. IGY Marinas has created standards for service and quality in nautical tourism. It offers a global network of marinas in the Americas, the Caribbean, Europe, and Asia, delivering year-round accommodations. IGY Marinas caters to a wide variety of luxury yachts, while also being exclusive home ports for some of the world's largest megayachts.

As of September 30, 2025, the Product Manufacturing segment included activity of Cruisers Yachts, a wholly-owned MarineMax subsidiary, manufacturing sport yacht and yachts with sales through our select retail dealership locations and through independent dealers, and Intrepid Powerboats. Cruisers Yachts is recognized as one of the world's premier manufacturers of premium sport yacht and yachts, including Aviara luxury dayboats, producing models from 33' to 60' feet. Intrepid Powerboats, also a wholly-owned MarineMax subsidiary, is a producer of customized boats, which incorporate the desires of each individual owner. Intrepid Powerboats sells through our retail dealership locations as well as independent dealers and has received many awards and accolades for its innovations and high-quality craftsmanship that create industry leading products in their categories.

In October 2022, we completed the acquisition of IGY Marinas. In December 2022, we acquired Midcoast Construction Enterprises, LLC ("Midcoast Marine Group"), a leading full-service marine construction company based on Central Florida's Gulf Coast. In January 2023, we acquired Boatzon, a boat and marine digital retail platform, through our recently formed technology entity, New Wave Innovations. In June 2023, we acquired C&C Boat Works, a full-service boat dealer in Crosslake, Minnesota. In October 2023, we acquired Atalanta Golden Yachts ("AGY"), a luxury charter management agency based in Athens, Greece. In March 2024, we acquired Williams Tenders USA ("Williams"), a premier distributor and retailer for UK-based Williams Jet Tenders Ltd., the world's leading manufacturer of rigid inflatable jet tenders for the luxury yacht market. In March 2024, we also acquired Native Marine, a boat dealer based in Islamorada, Florida. In October 2024, our Cruisers Yachts subsidiary assumed the rights to MasterCraft's Aviara brand of luxury dayboats. In January 2025, we acquired the service and parts departments of Treasure Island Marina in the Florida Panhandle. In March 2025, we acquired Shelter Bay Marina in Marathon, Florida.

We are the largest retailer of Sea Ray and Boston Whaler recreational boats which are manufactured by Brunswick Corporation ("Brunswick"). Sales of new Brunswick boats accounted for approximately 18% of our revenue in fiscal 2025. Sales of new Sea Ray and Boston Whaler boats, both divisions of Brunswick, accounted for approximately 8% and 9%, respectively, of our revenue in fiscal 2025. Brunswick is a world leading manufacturer of marine products and marine engines. We have agreements with Brunswick covering Sea Ray products and Boston Whaler products and are the exclusive dealer of Sea Ray and Boston Whaler boats in almost all of our geographic markets. Additionally, we are the exclusive dealer for Harris aluminum boats, a division of Brunswick, in many of our geographic markets. We also are the exclusive dealer for Italy-based Azimut-Benetti Group, or Azimut, for Azimut and Benetti mega-yachts, yachts, and other recreational boats for the United States. Sales of new Azimut boats and yachts accounted for approximately
6% of our revenue in fiscal 2025. Additionally, we are the exclusive dealer for certain other premium brands that serve certain industry segments in our markets as shown by the table on page three.

We also are involved in other boating-related activities. We sell used boats at our retail locations, online, and at various third-party marinas and other offsite locations; we sell marine engines and propellers, primarily to our retail customers as replacements for their existing engines and propellers; we sell a broad variety of parts and accessories at our retail locations and at various offsite locations, and through our print catalog; we offer maintenance, repair, and slip and storage rentals at most of our retail locations; we offer finance and insurance products at most of our retail locations and at various offsite locations and to our customers and independent boat dealers and brokers; we offer boat and yacht brokerage sales at most of our retail locations and at various offsite locations; and we conduct a charter business, which is based in the British Virgin Islands, in which we offer customers the opportunity to charter third-party and Company owned power catamarans.

MarineMax commenced operations as a result of the March 1, 1998 acquisition of five previously independent recreational boat dealers. Since that time, we have acquired 37 additional previously independent recreational boat dealers, multiple marinas, five boat brokerage operations, six superyacht service companies, two full-service yacht repair operations, and three boat and yacht manufacturers. We attempt to capitalize on the experience and success of the acquired companies in order to establish a high standard of customer service and responsiveness in the highly fragmented retail boating industry. As a result of our emphasis on premium brand boats, our average selling price for a new boat in fiscal 2025 was approximately $339,000, an increase from approximately $327,000 in fiscal 2024, compared with the industry average selling price for calendar 2024 of approximately $93,000 based on industry data published by the National Marine Manufacturers Association. We consider a store to be one or more retail locations that are adjacent or operate as one entity or a superyacht services region. Same-store sales include all stores that were open and operated throughout both the current and comparative prior period. Our same-store sales decreased 2% in fiscal 2023, increased 1% in fiscal 2024, and decreased 2% in fiscal 2025.

Our business strategy is focused on achieving sustainable, profitable growth and improving operational efficiency through the development of strong customer relationships and an expanded global presence within the recreational marine market. Established in 1998 as a U.S.-based recreational boat and yacht dealership, more recently, starting in 2019, we have broadened our international footprint and diversified our asset portfolio through strategic acquisitions of higher-margin businesses within the marine industry. Our portfolio includes a wide array of marine services, such as marina operations, storage solutions, finance and insurance services, superyacht brokerage and chartering, construction, boat manufacturing, and digital technology platforms. IGY Marinas ("IGY"), which we believe to be the only global marina operator, provides a network of marina locations across the Americas, the Caribbean, Europe, and Asia. Many of our revenue streams, including IGY, reinforce our vertically integrated model and allow us to support customers across the entire recreational marine value chain.

We further advanced our growth strategy in fiscal 2024, acquiring a controlling interest in Atalanta Golden Yachts ("AGY"), a prominent yacht charter management company in Greece. This acquisition complements our existing superyacht brokerage and luxury yacht offerings. We also enhanced the operational efficiencies of our superyacht brands by establishing a SuperYacht Division, which consolidates back-office functions across AGY, Fraser Yachts, Northrop & Johnson, Fairport Yacht Management, and SuperYacht Management, creating a unified support infrastructure. In addition, we acquired Williams, a leading distributor and retailer of rigid inflatable jet tenders for the luxury yacht market. And in October 2024, our Cruisers Yachts subsidiary assumed the rights to MasterCraft's Aviara brand of luxury dayboats. In January 2025, we acquired the service and parts departments at our retail location in Panama City Beach, Florida. In March 2025, we acquired Shelter Bay Marina in Marathon, Florida.

Further, in fiscal 2025, we continued to advance our digital technology initiatives. Through platforms such as Boatzon and Boatyard, which are proprietary customer experience solutions tailored for the marine industry, and with the support of our technology-focused entity, New Wave Innovations, we aim to enhance customer engagement and drive additional value across our portfolio.

Since our initial acquisitions in March 1998, we have acquired 37 additional previously independent recreational boat dealers, multiple marinas, five boat brokerage operations, six superyacht service companies, two full-service yacht repair operations, and three boat and yacht manufacturers. Acquired dealers operate under the MarineMax name.

We continually attempt to enhance our business by providing a full range of services, offering extensive and high-quality product lines, maintaining prime retail locations, pursuing the MarineMax One Price hassle-free sales approach, and emphasizing a high level of customer service and satisfaction.

headings: Risks Related to Competition, Economic, and Industry Conditions
Boat manufacturers exercise substantial control over our business.
Our business, as well as the entire recreational boating industry, is highly seasonal, with seasonality varying in different geographic markets.
The failure to receive rebates and other dealer incentives (interest assistance and co-op assistance) on inventory purchases or retail sales could substantially reduce our margins.
Other recreational activities, poor industry perception, and potential health risks from environmental conditions can adversely affect the levels of boat purchases.
Timing of large boat and yacht sales and failure to adequately anticipate consumer preference and demand may have an adverse impact on our business.
Economic conditions and consumer spending patterns can have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Our sales have been, and may further be, adversely impacted by recent increases in interest rates and adverse changes in fiscal policy or credit market conditions.
Inflation could adversely affect our financial results.
Changes in accounting standards could significantly affect our results of operations and the presentation of those results.
Failure to implement strategies to enhance our performance or our strategies could have a material adverse effect on our business and financial condition.

Our success depends, in part, on our ability to continue to make successful acquisitions at attractive or fair prices and to integrate the operations of acquired dealers and each dealer we acquire in the future.
We may pursue acquisition strategies in new lines of business.
Unforeseen expenses, difficulties, and delays frequently encountered in connection with expansion through acquisitions could inhibit our growth and negatively impact our profitability.
We may be required to obtain the consent of Brunswick and various other manufacturers prior to the acquisition of other dealers.
Our internal growth and operating strategies of opening new locations and offering new products involve risk.
The intended benefits of the IGY Marinas acquisition may not be realized.
The Ukraine and Middle East conflicts could have a significant adverse effect on our business, results of operations, financial condition, and cash flow in the future.
The availability and costs of borrowed funds can adversely affect our ability to obtain adequate boat inventory and the ability and willingness of our customers to finance boat purchases.
Higher energy, costs and availability of raw materials, parts, components, and fuel costs along with adequate supply may adversely affect our business.
Substantially all of our products are powered with outboard engines from Mercury Marine, Yamaha, and inboard engines from Volvo, which makes us reliant on these companies for the supply of engines.
The availability of boat insurance is critical to our success.
Elements of our yacht charter and charter brokerage businesses expose us to certain risks.
We depend on income from financing, insurance and extended service contracts.
Our continued success is dependent on positive perceptions of our MarineMax brand which, if impaired, could adversely affect our sales.
Our operations are dependent upon key personnel and team members.
The products we sell, or services we provide, may expose us to potential liabilities for personal injury or property damage claims relating to the use of those products.
We manufacture and sell products that create exposure to potential claims and litigation.
We have a fixed cost base that can affect our profitability if demand decreases.
Adverse federal tax, state tax, or governmental regulations and policies can have a negative effect on us.
Marinas may not be readily adaptable to other uses.
We may be unable to obtain, renew or maintain permits, licenses and approvals necessary for the operation of our marinas.
Changes in the assumptions used to calculate our acquisition related contingent consideration liabilities could have a material adverse impact on our financial results.
An impairment in the carrying value of long-lived assets and goodwill could negatively impact our financial results and net worth.
paragraphs: Our success depends to a significant extent on the well-being, as well as the continued popularity and reputation for quality of the boating products, of our manufacturers, particularly Brunswick's Sea Ray and Boston Whaler boat lines, Azimut-Benetti Group's Azimut products and Mercury Marine engines. The failure to obtain a high quality and desirable mix of competitively priced products that our customers demand could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

Approximately 18% of our revenue in fiscal 2025 resulted from sales of new boats manufactured by Brunswick, including approximately 8% from Brunswick's Sea Ray division, 9% from Brunswick's Boston Whaler division, and approximately 1% from Brunswick's other divisions. Additionally, approximately 6% of our revenue in fiscal 2025 resulted from sales of new boats manufactured by Azimut-Benetti Group. The remainder of our fiscal 2025 revenue from new boat sales resulted from sales of products from a limited number of other manufacturers, none of which accounted for more than 10% of our revenue.

We depend on our manufacturers to provide us with products that compare favorably with competing products in terms of quality, performance, safety, and advanced features, including the latest advances in propulsion and navigation systems. Any adverse change in the production efficiency, product development efforts, technological advancement, expansion of manufacturing footprint, supply chain and third-party suppliers, marketplace acceptance, marketing capabilities, ability to secure adequate access to capital, and financial condition of our manufacturers, particularly Brunswick (including Mercury Marine, a division of Brunswick) and Azimut-Benetti Group, given our reliance on Sea Ray, Boston Whaler, Mercury Marine engines, and Azimut, would have a substantial adverse impact on our business. Any difficulties encountered by any of our manufacturers, particularly Brunswick and Azimut-Benetti Group, resulting from economic, financial, supply chain, or other factors could adversely affect the quality and amount of products that they are able to supply to us and the services and support they provide to us.

Any interruption or discontinuance of the operations of Brunswick, Azimut-Benetti Group or other manufacturers could cause us to experience shortfalls, disruptions or delays with respect to needed inventory. Although we believe in our brand, our product diversification and that adequate alternate sources would be available that could replace any manufacturer other than Brunswick and Azimut-Benetti Group as a product source, those alternate sources may not be available at the time of any interruption, and alternative products may not be available at comparable quality and price.

We depend on our dealer agreements. We have dealer agreements with Brunswick covering Sea Ray and Boston Whaler products. Most of our retail locations have a multi-year dealer agreement which provides for the lowest product prices charged by the Sea Ray division of Brunswick or Boston Whaler, as applicable, from time to time to other domestic Sea Ray or Boston Whaler dealers, as applicable. We also own Fraser Yachts Group, a leading superyacht brokerage and luxury yacht services company with operations in multiple countries, Northrop & Johnson, another leading superyacht brokerage and services company with operations in multiple countries, SkipperBud's, one of the largest boat sales, brokerage, service and marina/storage groups in the United States, and Cruisers Yachts, a manufacturer of sport yacht and yachts, including Aviara luxury dayboats, with sales through our select retail dealership locations and through independent dealers.

MarineMax was incorporated in January 1998 (and reincorporated in Florida in March 2015). We commenced operations with the acquisition of five independent recreational boat dealers on March 1, 1998. Since the initial acquisitions in March 1998, we have, as of the filing of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, acquired 37 recreational boat dealers, five boat brokerage operations, six superyacht service companies, two full-service yacht repair operations and three boat and yacht manufacturers. As a part of our acquisition strategy, we frequently engage in discussions with various recreational boat dealers regarding their potential acquisition by us. Potential acquisition discussions frequently take place over a long period of time and involve difficult business integration and other issues, including, in some cases, management succession and related matters. As a result of these and other factors, a number of potential acquisitions that from time to time appear likely to occur do not result in binding legal agreements and are not consummated. We completed four acquisitions in the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, three acquisitions in the fiscal year ended September 30, 2024, and three acquisitions in the fiscal year ending September 30, 2025.

General economic conditions and consumer spending patterns can negatively impact our operating results. Unfavorable local, regional, national or global economic developments or uncertainties regarding future economic prospects could reduce consumer spending in the markets we serve and adversely affect our business. Economic conditions in areas in which we operate dealerships, particularly Florida where we generated approximately 54%, 53%, and 53% of our dealership revenue during fiscal 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively, can have a major impact on our operations. Local influences, such as corporate downsizing, military base closings, and inclement weather such as hurricanes and other storms, environmental conditions, and specific events, such as the BP oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico in 2010, also could adversely affect, and in certain instances have adversely affected, our operations in certain markets.

In an economic downturn, consumer discretionary spending levels generally decline, at times resulting in disproportionately large reductions in the sale of luxury goods. Consumer spending on luxury goods also may decline as a result of lower consumer confidence levels, even if prevailing economic conditions are favorable. Additionally, although the Federal Reserve has recently cut interest rates, its prior increases of its benchmark interest rate resulted in significantly higher long-term interest rates, which negatively impacted, and may continue to negatively impact, our customers' willingness or desire to purchase our products. As a result, an economic downturn or inflation could impact us more than certain of our competitors due to our strategic focus on a higher end of our market.. Although we have expanded our operations during periods of stagnant or modestly declining industry trends, the cyclical nature of the recreational

boating industry or the lack of industry growth may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations. Any period of adverse economic conditions, low consumer confidence or inflation is likely to have a negative effect on our business.

Historically, in periods of lower consumer spending and depressed economic conditions, we have, among other things, substantially reduced our acquisition program, delayed new store openings, reduced our inventory purchases, engaged in inventory reduction efforts, closed a number of our retail locations, reduced our headcount, and amended and replaced our credit facility.

Although past economic conditions have adversely affected our operating results, we believe during and after such conditions we have capitalized on our core strengths to substantially outperform the industry, resulting in market share gains. Our ability to capture such market share supports the alignment of our retailing strategies with the desires of consumers. We believe the steps we have taken to address weak market conditions in the past have yielded, and we believe are likely to yield in the future, an increase in revenue. Acquisitions remain an important strategy for us, and, subject to a number of conditions, including macro-economic conditions and finding attractive acquisition targets, we plan to explore opportunities through this strategy. We expect our core strengths and retailing strategies including our digital platform, will position us to capitalize on growth opportunities as they occur and will allow us to emerge with greater earnings potential.

We have identified the policies below as critical to our business operations and the understanding of our results of operations. The impact and risks related to these policies on our business operations are discussed throughout "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" when such policies affect our reported and expected financial results.

In the ordinary course of business, we make a number of estimates and assumptions relating to the reporting of results of operations and financial condition in the preparation of our consolidated financial statements in conformity with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States. We base our estimates on historical experiences and on various other assumptions (including future earnings) that we believe are reasonable under the circumstances. The results of these assumptions form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities, including contingent assets and liabilities such as contingent consideration liabilities from acquisitions, which are not readily apparent from other sources. Actual results could differ significantly from those estimates under different assumptions and conditions. We believe that the following discussion addresses our most critical accounting policies, which are those that are most important to the portrayal of our financial condition and results of operations and require our most difficult, subjective, and complex judgments, often as a result of the need to make estimates about the effect of matters that are inherently uncertain.

We recognize revenue from boat, motor, and trailer sales upon transfer of control of the boat, motor, or trailer to the customer, which is generally upon acceptance of the boat, motor, and trailer by the customer and the satisfaction of our performance obligations. The transaction price is determined with the customer at the time of sale. Customers may trade in a used boat to apply toward the purchase of a new or used boat. The trade-in is a type of noncash consideration measured at fair value, based on external and internal observable and unobservable market data and applied as payment to the contract price for the purchased boat. paragraphs: 我們認為本公司為全球最大的休閒船隻與遊艇零售商、碼頭營運商及豪華遊艇服務公司。截至2025年9月30日，本公司在全球擁有超過120個據點，包括超過70個零售經銷據點，其中部分據點設有碼頭。透過IGY收購，截至2025年9月30日，本公司擁有或營運超過65個碼頭與儲存據點。透過Fraser Yachts與Northrop & Johnson，我們認為本公司為全球最大豪華遊艇服務供應商，營運據點遍佈全球。Cruisers Yachts、Aviara豪華日用船隻與Intrepid Powerboats皆製造船隻與遊艇，並透過我們的選擇性零售經銷據點與獨立經銷商認購銷售。MarineMax透過全資子公司提供財務與保險服務，並在英屬維爾京羣島的Tortola營運MarineMax Vacations。本公司透過全資子公司New Wave Innovations，亦擁有Boatyard，一家行業領先的客戶體驗數位產品公司，以及Boatzon，一家船隻與海事數位零售平台。透過Newcoast Financial Services，本公司提供第三方財務與保險產品，主要用於與我們零售據點無關的交易。

截至2025年9月30日，零售營運分部包含位於美國阿拉巴馬州、加利福尼亞州、康涅狄格州、佛羅裏達州、喬治亞州、伊利諾州、馬裏蘭州、麻薩諸塞州、密歇根州、明尼蘇達州、密蘇裏州、新澤西州、紐約州、北卡羅來納州、俄亥俄州、奧克拉荷馬州、羅德島州、南卡羅來納州、德克薩斯州、華盛頓州與威斯康辛州的超過70個零售據點，我們銷售新舊休閒船隻，包括娛樂與釣魚船隻，並專注於各個分部的高階品牌。我們亦銷售相關海事產品，包括引擎、拖車、零件與配件。此外，我們提供修復、維護與船隻泊位與儲存租賃；我們安排相關船隻財務、保險與延長服務合約；我們提供船隻與遊艇經紀銷售與遊艇租賃服務。在英屬維爾京羣島，我們透過MarineMax Vacations提供動力雙體船隻的租賃服務。Fraser Yachts Group與Northrop & Johnson，為領先的豪華遊艇經紀與 luxury 遊艇服務公司，營運據點遍及多個國家，亦包含於此分部。IGY Marinas亦包含於此分部。IGY Marinas維護一個 strategically positioned 的豪華碼頭網路，設於全球遊艇與運動釣魚目的地。IGY Marinas已建立航海旅遊服務與品質的標準。其提供全球美洲、加勒比海、歐洲與亞洲的碼頭網路，提供全年無休的住宿服務。IGY Marinas服務多種豪華遊艇，同時亦為部分全球最大 megayachts 的專屬停泊港。

截至2025年9月30日，產品製造分部包含Cruisers Yachts，為MarineMax全資子公司，製造運動遊艇與遊艇，銷售透過我們的選擇性零售經銷據點與獨立經銷商，以及Intrepid Powerboats。Cruisers Yachts被認為是全球首屈一指的高階運動遊艇與遊艇製造商，包括Aviara豪華日用船隻，生產33'至60'英尺的船隻模型。Intrepid Powerboats，亦為MarineMax全資子公司，為製造客製化船隻的公司，其 incorporates 每個個別所有者的願望。Intrepid Powerboats透過我們的零售經銷據點與獨立經銷商銷售，並因其創新與高品質工藝而獲得許多獎項與讚譽，創造其所在類別的行業領先產品。

2022年10月，本公司完成IGY Marinas的收購。2022年12月，本公司收購Midcoast Construction Enterprises, LLC（"Midcoast Marine Group"），一家位於美國佛羅裏達州中部海岸的領先全服務海事建設公司。2023年1月，本公司透過新成立的科技公司New Wave Innovations收購Boatzon，一家船隻與海事數位零售平台。2023年6月，本公司收購C&C Boat Works，一家位於明尼蘇達州Crosslake的全服務船隻經銷商。2023年10月，本公司收購Atalanta Golden Yachts（"AGY"），一家位於希臘雅典的豪華租賃管理機構。2024年3月，本公司收購Williams Tenders USA（"Williams"），一家美國的首屈一指的英國Williams Jet Tenders Ltd.經銷商與零售商，該公司為全球領先的豪華遊艇市場的剛性充氣式噴水艇製造商。2024年3月，本公司亦收購Native Marine，一家位於佛羅裏達州Islamorada的船隻經銷商。2024年10月，本公司Cruisers Yachts子公司取得MasterCraft的Aviara品牌豪華日用船隻的權利。2025年1月，本公司收購Treasure Island Marina的服務與零件部門，位於佛羅裏達州Panhandle。2025年3月，本公司收購位於佛羅裏達州Marathon的Shelter Bay Marina。

本公司為全球最大銷售Sea Ray與Boston Whaler休閒船隻的零售商，這些船隻由Brunswick Corporation（"Brunswick"）製造。2025財年，銷售新Brunswick船隻約佔本公司營業收入的18%。銷售新Sea Ray與Boston Whaler船隻，皆為Brunswick的部門，約佔本公司營業收入的8%與9%。Brunswick為全球領先的海事產品與海事引擎製造商。本公司與Brunswick有協議，涵蓋Sea Ray與Boston Whaler產品，並為Sea Ray與Boston Whaler船隻在幾乎所有地理市場的獨家經銷商。此外，本公司亦為Harris鋁製船隻，Brunswick的部門，在許多地理市場的獨家經銷商。本公司亦為義大利的Azimut-Benetti Group（或Azimut）的獨家經銷商，銷售Azimut與Benetti豪華遊艇、遊艇及其他休閒船隻於美國。銷售新Azimut船隻與遊艇約佔本公司營業收入的
6% of our revenue in fiscal 2025. Additionally, we are the exclusive dealer for certain other premium brands that serve certain industry segments in our markets as shown by the table on page three.

本公司亦參與其他與船隻相關的活動。我們在零售據點、線上與各類第三方碼頭及其他離線據點銷售二手船隻；我們銷售海事引擎與螺旋槳，主要供應我們的零售客戶作為其現有引擎與螺旋槳的替換；我們在零售據點與各類離線據點銷售廣泛的零件與配件，並透過印刷目錄銷售；我們在大多數零售據點提供維護、修復與船隻泊位與儲存租賃服務；我們在大多數零售據點與各類離線據點為客戶與獨立船隻經銷商與經紀人提供財務與保險產品；我們在大多數零售據點與各類離線據點提供船隻與遊艇經紀銷售服務；我們進行租賃業務，該業務基地於英屬維爾京羣島，我們為客戶提供租賃第三方與本公司所有的動力雙體船隻的機會。

MarineMax自1998年3月1日收購五家零售公司後成立，並致力於利用收購公司的經驗與成功，以在高度分散的零售船隻產業中建立高標準的客戶服務與反應速度。由於我們專注於高階品牌船隻，2025財年我們新船的平均銷售價格約為$339,000，較2024財年的約$327,000有所增加，而根據國家海事製造商協會發佈的2024年日曆年平均銷售價格約為$93,000。我們認為一家商店為一個或更多相鄰或營運為一個實體的零售據點，或為一個豪華遊艇服務區域。同店銷售包含所有在當前與比較前一財年期間均開放並營運的商店。我們的同店銷售在2023財年下降2%，在2024財年增加1%，在2025財年下降2%。

本公司業務策略著重於實現可持續且獲利的成長，並透過建立強大的客戶關係與擴大在全球的據點，提升營運效率，以進佔休閒船隻市場。本公司於1998年成立，為美國的休閒船隻與遊艇經銷商，近年來，自2019年起，我們已擴大國際據點，並透過戰略性收購總體經濟較佳的業者，來多元化我們的資產組合。我們的組合包含多樣化的船隻相關服務，例如碼頭營運、儲存解決方案、金融與保險服務、超級遊艇經紀與租賃、建造、船隻製造與數位科技平台。IGY Marinas（"IGY"），我們認為是唯一全球碼頭營運商，提供美洲、加勒比海、歐洲與亞洲的碼頭據點網路。許多我們的收入來源，包括IGY，強化了我們垂直整合的模式，使我們能支持客戶於休閒船隻價值鏈的各個階段。

我們在財務年度2024年進一步推進成長策略，取得Atalanta Golden Yachts（"AGY"）的控制權，AGY為希臘著名的遊艇租賃管理公司。此收購補強我們現有的超級遊艇經紀與豪華遊艇產品線。我們也透過設立SuperYacht Division來提升超級遊艇品牌的營運效率，該部門整合AGY、Fraser Yachts、Northrop & Johnson、Fairport Yacht Management與SuperYacht Management的後勤作業，建立統一的支援基礎設施。此外，我們取得Williams，為豪華遊艇市場的領導性經銷與零售商。2024年10月，我們的Cruisers Yachts子公司取得MasterCraft的Aviara品牌豪華日用船隻。2025年1月，我們取得佛羅裏達州Panama City Beach零售據點的服務與零件部門。2025年3月，我們取得佛羅裏達州Marathon的Shelter Bay Marina。
此外，在財務年度2025年，我們持續推進數位科技計畫。透過Boatzon與Boatyard等專屬的客戶體驗平台，這些平台為船隻產業量身打造，並配合我們專注於科技的實體New Wave Innovations，我們旨在提升客戶參與度，並在整體組閤中創造更多價值。
自1998年首次收購以來，我們已取得37家原先獨立的休閒船隻經銷商、多個碼頭、五家船隻經紀機構、六家超級遊艇服務公司、兩家完整的遊艇維修服務機構，以及三家船隻與遊艇製造商。取得的經銷商均以MarineMax為名營運。
我們持續努力提升業務，透過提供完整的服務項目、提供廣泛且高品質的產品線、維持優質的零售據點、採用MarineMax One Price無煩惱銷售方式，並強調高水準的客戶服務與滿意度。
我們偶爾也會評估擴展營運的機會，例如透過收購休閒船隻經銷商來擴大地理範圍、擴充產品線、在現有據點內或外開設新的零售據點，以及

paragraphs: 以下內容應與第一部分，包括本報告中「風險因素」節所述事項，以及我們合併財務報表及其附註，並包含於本報告其他地方，一併閱讀。本形式 10-K 的此部分一般討論財務年度 2025 及 2024 的項目，以及財務年度 2025 與 2024 之間的年對年比較。有關財務年度 2023 的項目及財務年度 2024 與 2023 之間的年對年比較，未包含於本形式 10-K 中的內容，可於本公司 2024 年 9 月 30 日財務年度的年度報告形式 10-K 中的「管理層對財務狀況及營運結果之討論與分析」部分，第二部分，第 7 項找到。

我們認為我們是全球最大的休閒船隻與遊艇零售商、碼頭經營者及豪華遊艇服務公司。透過我們在 21 個州設有超過 70 個零售據點，我們銷售新舊休閒船隻及相關海洋產品，包括引擎、拖車、零件及配件。我們也安排相關的船隻貸款、保險及延長服務合約；提供船隻維修與保養服務；提供遊艇與船隻經紀銷售服務；並在有提供的情況下，提供船位與儲存設施。在百慕達羣島，我們透過 MarineMax Vacations 提供帆船租賃服務。我們也擁有 Fraser Yachts Group，為一間領先的豪華遊艇經紀與服務公司，業務遍及多個國家；Northrop & Johnson，另一間領先的豪華遊艇經紀與服務公司，業務遍及多個國家；SkipperBud's，美國最大的船隻銷售、經紀、服務與碼頭/儲存集團之一；以及 Cruisers Yachts，為一間生產運動遊艇與遊艇的製造商，包括 Aviara 豪華日用船隻，銷售透過我們選擇的零售經銷據點及獨立經銷商進行。

2022 年 10 月，我們完成對 IGY Marinas 的收購。IGY Marinas 保有位於全球遊艇與運動釣魚目的地的豪華碼頭網路。IGY Marinas 已建立遊艇旅遊服務的標準與品質。其提供美洲、加勒比、歐洲及亞洲的全球碼頭網路，提供全年無間斷的住宿設施。IGY Marinas 服務多種豪華遊艇，同時也是部分全球最大豪華遊艇的專屬母港。2022 年 12 月，我們收購 Midcoast Marine Group，為一間位於美國佛羅裏達州中部海岸的領先全服務海洋建設公司。2023 年 1 月，我們透過新成立的科技公司 New Wave Innovations 收購 Boatzon，為一間船隻與海洋數位零售平台。2023 年 6 月，我們收購 C&C Boat Works，為一間位於明尼蘇達州 Crosslake 的全服務船隻經銷商。2023 年 10 月，我們收購 AGY，為一間位於希臘雅典的豪華遊艇租賃管理機構。2024 年 3 月，我們收購 Williams，為一間英國基於 Williams Jet Tenders Ltd. 的首選經銷商與零售商，為全球領先的豪華遊艇市場的剛性充氣式噴水船製造商。2024 年 3 月，我們也收購 Native Marine，為一間位於佛羅裏達州 Islamorada 的船隻經銷商。2024 年 10 月，我們的 Cruisers Yachts 子公司取得 MasterCraft 的 Aviara 品牌豪華日用船隻的權利。2025 年 1 月，我們收購佛羅裏達州 Panama City Beach 儲存據點的服務與零件部門。2025 年 3 月，我們收購佛羅裏達州 Marathon 的 Shelter Bay Marina。

MarineMax 於 1998 年 1 月成立（並於 2015 年 3 月重新註冊為佛羅裏達州公司）。我們於 1998 年 3 月 1 日透過收購五間獨立的休閒船隻經銷商開始營運。自 1998 年 3 月的初始收購以來，截至本年度報告形式 10-K 提交時，我們已收購 37 間休閒船隻經銷商、五間船隻經紀營運、六間豪華遊艇服務公司、兩間全服務遊艇維修營運及三間船隻與遊艇製造商。根據我們的收購策略，我們經常與各個休閒船隻經銷商進行討論，評估其是否可能被我們收購。潛在收購討論通常會持續一段很長的時間，並涉及困難的業務整合及其他問題，包括在某些情況下，管理層繼任及相關事項。因此，由於這些及其他因素，許多潛在收購案即使在某些時候看起來可能發生，卻未形成具有約束力的法律協議，也未完成交易。我們在 2023 年 9 月 30 日財務年度完成四項收購，在 2024 年 9 月 30 日財務年度完成三項收購，在 2025 年 9 月 30 日財務年度完成三項收購。

總體經濟條件及消費者支出模式可能對我們的營運結果產生負面影響。不利的本地、區域、國家或全球經濟發展或對未來經濟前景的不確定性，可能減少我們服務市場的消費者支出，並對我們的業務產生不利影響。我們經營的經銷商所在地區的經濟條件，特別是在佛羅裏達州，我們在財務年度 2025、2024 及 2023 分別產生約 54%、53% 及 53% 的經銷商營收，可能對我們的營運產生重大影響。本地因素，如企業縮編、軍事基地關閉、以及如颶風及其他風暴等惡劣天氣、環境條件，以及特定事件，如 2010 年墨西哥灣 BP 油汙事件，也可能對我們在某些市場的營運產生不利影響，並在某些情況下已對我們的營運產生不利影響。

在經濟衰退期間，消費者可支配支出通常會下降，有時導致豪華商品銷售出現不成比例的大幅減少。消費者對豪華商品的支出也可能因消費者信心水平下降而減少，即使當前經濟條件良好。此外，雖然聯邦儲備委員會最近已降低利率，但其先前提高基準利率導致長期利率顯著上升，這對我們客戶購買我們產品的意願或慾望產生負面影響，並可能繼續產生負面影響。因此，經濟衰退或通貨膨脹可能對我們的影響，可能比某些競爭對手更大，這是因為我們戰略上專注於市場的高端部分。儘管我們在產業趨勢處於停滯或小幅下降期間擴展了業務，但休閒船隻產業的週期性或產業成長不足，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。
任何一段不利的經濟條件、低消費者信心或通貨膨脹時期，很可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
歷史上，在消費者支出減少及經濟低迷時期，我們已採取多種措施，包括大幅減少收購計劃、延遲新店開幕、減少存貨採購、進行存貨減量措施、關閉多間零售據點、減少員工人數，以及修改並更換信用融資設施。

儘管過去的經濟環境已對我們的營運結果造成不利影響，我們認為在這些環境期間及之後，我們已善用核心優勢，大幅超越產業表現，導致市佔率增加。我們有能力捕捉這樣的市佔率，支持我們的零售策略與消費者需求的對齊。我們認為過去為應對弱勢市場環境所採取的措施已產生效益，且我們相信這些措施未來也將產生效益。收購仍是我們的重要策略，且在符合多項條件，包括總體經濟環境與找到具吸引力的收購目標的前提下，我們計畫透過此策略探索機會。我們預期透過核心優勢與零售策略，包括我們的數位平台，將能抓住成長機會，並使我們在未來擁有更高的獲利潛力。

截至2025年9月30日，零售營運分部包括美國阿拉巴馬州、加州、康乃狄格州、佛羅裏達州、喬治亞州、伊利諾州、馬裏蘭州、麻薩諸塞州、密歇根州、明尼蘇達州、密蘇裏州、新澤西州、紐約州、北卡羅來納州、俄亥俄州、奧克拉荷馬州、羅德島州、南卡羅來納州、德州、華盛頓州與威斯康辛州超過70個零售據點的活動，我們在這些據點銷售新舊休閒船隻，包括娛樂與釣魚船隻，並在每個分部中專注於高階品牌。我們也銷售相關的船隻產品，包括引擎、拖車、零件與配件。此外，我們提供修復、保養與船隻泊位與儲存租賃服務；我們安排相關的船隻貸款、保險與延長服務合約；並提供船隻與遊艇經紀銷售與遊艇租賃服務。在百慕達羣島，我們透過MarineMax Vacations提供貓型船隻的租賃服務。Fraser Yachts Group與Northrop & Johnson為領先的超級遊艇經紀與豪華遊艇服務公司，業務遍及多個國家，也包含在本分部中。透過IGY Marinas，也包含在本分部中，我們維護一個 strategically positioned 豪華船隻碼頭網路，位於全球船隻與運動釣魚旅遊目的地。零售營運分部包含大部分的公司總部費用。

截至2025年9月30日，產品製造分部包含Cruisers Yachts與Intrepid Powerboats的活動。Cruisers Yachts為MarineMax的 wholly-owned 子公司，製造運動遊艇與遊艇，包括Aviara豪華日用船隻，銷售透過我們選擇的零售經銷據點與獨立經銷商。Cruisers Yachts被公認為全球首屈一指的高階運動遊艇與遊艇製造商，生產從33英尺至60英尺的船隻。Intrepid Powerboats為MarineMax的 wholly-owned 子公司，為客製化船隻製造商。Intrepid Powerboats透過我們的零售經銷據點與獨立經銷商銷售，並因其創新與高品質工藝而獲得許多獎項與好評，創造其類別中的產業領先產品。
我們已識別出以下政策為對我們營運與瞭解我們營運結果至關重要的政策。這些政策對我們營運的影響與風險在「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」中進行討論，當這些政策影響我們報告與預期的財務結果時。

在營運過程中，我們會做出許多與報告營運結果與財務狀況相關的估計與假設，以符合美國通用會計準則的財務報表編製。我們的估計基於歷史經驗與各種其他假設（包括未來獲利），我們認為在當時情況下這些假設是合理的。這些假設的結果成為我們對資產與負債價值做出判斷的基礎，包括 contingent assets 與 liabilities，例如來自收購的 contingent consideration liabilities，這些並非來自其他來源的明確資訊。實際結果可能因不同假設與條件而顯著不同。我們認為以下討論涵蓋了我們最重要的會計政策，這些政策對我們財務狀況與營運結果的呈現至關重要，且需要我們做出最困難、主觀與複雜的判斷，通常因需要估計某些本質上不確定的事件的影響所致。

我們在船隻、馬達與拖車銷售時，於將船隻、馬達或拖車的控制權轉移給客戶時確認收入，這通常是在客戶接受船隻、馬達與拖車並滿足我們的履行義務時。交易價格在銷售時與客戶確定。客戶可能以舊船隻折抵新船隻或舊船隻的購買。折抵是一種非現金考慮，以公平價值衡量，基於外部與內部可觀察與不可觀察的市場資料，並應用於購買船隻的合約價格。在接受時，客戶可指示使用船隻、馬達或拖車，並獲得 substantially all 的利益。我們確認

headings: 與競爭、經濟及產業條件相關的風險
船隻製造商對我們的業務擁有相當大的控制力。
我們的業務以及整個休閒船隻產業皆具有高度季節性，且不同地理市場的季節性表現會有所差異。
未能獲得庫存購買新車回扣及其他經銷商激勵措施（利息協助及合作協助）可能會顯著降低我們的毛利率。
其他休閒活動、產業形象不佳以及環境條件可能帶來的健康風險，可能會對船隻購買新車的數量產生不利影響。
我們面臨強烈的競爭壓力。
大型船隻與遊艇銷售的時機以及未能充分預測消費者偏好與需求，可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
經濟條件與消費者支出模式可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
本公司銷售額已受到，且可能進一步受到近期利率上漲及財政政策或信貸市場條件惡化之不利影響。
通貨膨脹可能對本公司財務結果造成不利影響。
會計準則之變更可能對本公司營運結果及該結果之呈現產生重大影響。
與本公司策略相關之風險
未能實施提升本公司營運績效或本公司策略，可能對本公司業務及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
本公司之成功在一定程度上取決於本公司持續以合理或公平價格成功進行收購，並整合所收購經銷商之營運，以及未來所收購之每一經銷商之營運。
本公司可能在新業務領域進行收購策略。
透過收購進行擴張時，經常會遇到預料之外之費用、困難及延誤，這些情況可能抑制本公司之成長，並對本公司之獲利能力造成負面影響。
我們可能需要獲得Brunswick及各其他製造商的同意，才能取得其他經銷商。
我們內部成長及營運策略，包括開設新據點及提供新產品，涉及風險。
IGY Marinas收購預期的效益可能無法實現。
烏克蘭與中東衝突可能對我們未來的業務、營運結果、財務狀況及現金流產生重大不利影響。
與我們營運相關的風險
取得貸款資金的可得性及成本可能不利於我們取得足夠船隻存貨的能力，以及我們客戶對購船貸款的意願與能力。
更高的能源、原材料、零件、零組件及燃料成本，以及足夠的供應，可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們 substantially all 的產品皆使用 Mercury Marine、Yamaha 的外燃機，以及 Volvo 的內燃機，這使我們依賴這些公司提供引擎的供應。
船隻保險的可取得性對我們的成功至關重要。
我們的遊艇包租及包租經紀業務某些要素使我們面臨特定風險。
我們依賴來自融資、保險及延長服務合約的收入。
我們持續的成功取決於外界對我們MarineMax品牌的正面看法，若該品牌受損，可能會對我們的銷售產生不利影響。
我們的業務運作依賴關鍵人員及團隊成員。
我們所銷售的產品，或所提供的服務，可能使我們面臨與使用這些產品相關的個人傷害或財產損壞聲請的潛在責任。
我們製造並銷售可能使我們面臨潛在聲請及訴訟的產品。
我們擁有固定成本基礎，若需求下降，可能會影響我們的利潤表現。
不利的聯邦稅收、州稅收或政府規範與政策可能對我們產生負面影響。
碼頭可能無法輕易轉作其他用途。
我們可能無法取得、更新或維持經營碼頭所需許可證、執照及核准。
用以計算我們與併購相關或有考量負債之假設條件變動，可能對我們財務結果產生重大負面影響。
長期資產及商譽之攤銷價值減損，可能對我們財務結果及權益產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 我們的成功在很大程度上取決於製造商的狀況，以及其船隻產品的受歡迎程度與品質聲譽，特別是Brunswick的Sea Ray與Boston Whaler船系列、Azimut-Benetti Group的Azimut產品與Mercury Marine引擎。若無法取得客戶所需求的高品質且具競爭力價格的產品組合，將對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成重大不利影響。

我們在財務年度2025年的營業收入約有18%來自Brunswick製造的新船銷售，其中包括約8%來自Brunswick的Sea Ray部門、9%來自Brunswick的Boston Whaler部門，以及約1%來自Brunswick其他部門。此外，我們在財務年度2025年的營業收入約有6%來自Azimut-Benetti Group製造的新船銷售。財務年度2025年我們來自新船銷售的營業收入餘下部分來自少數其他製造商的產品銷售，其中沒有任何製造商的銷售額超過我們營業收入的10%。

我們依賴製造商提供與競爭產品相比在品質、性能、安全及先進功能方面具有優勢的產品，包括最新進步的推進與導航系統。若製造商的生產效率、產品開發努力、技術進步、製造基地擴張、供應鏈與第三方供應商、市場接受度、行銷能力、取得足夠資金的能力建立及財務狀況出現不利變化，特別是Brunswick（包括Mercury Marine，為Brunswick的部門）與Azimut-Benetti Group，因我們依賴Sea Ray、Boston Whaler、Mercury Marine引擎與Azimut產品，將對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。任何製造商，特別是Brunswick與Azimut-Benetti Group，因經濟、財務、供應鏈或其他因素所遭遇的困難，可能影響其能供應給我們的產品品質與數量，以及所提供的服務與支援。
若Brunswick、Azimut-Benetti Group或其他製造商的營運中斷或終止，我們可能會面臨所需存貨的短缺、中斷或延誤。雖然我們相信我們的品牌、產品多元化以及有足夠的替代來源可以取代Brunswick與Azimut-Benetti Group以外的任何製造商作為產品來源，但在任何中斷時點，這些替代來源可能無法取得，且替代產品可能無法以相當的品質與價格取得。
我們依賴經銷商契約。我們與Brunswick有經銷商契約，涵蓋Sea Ray與Boston Whaler產品。我們大多數零售據點都有多年經銷商契約，該契約規定提供給其他國內Sea Ray或Boston Whaler經銷商的產品價格為Sea Ray部門或Boston Whaler部門當時所收取的最低價格。這些條款受以下條件限制：
• 經銷商符合製造商適用計畫的所有要求與條件；
